results.content:
The ‌agent works directly inside Google ‌Workspace apps including Gmail, Docs, Sheets and Calendar, and can also be used through Microsoft 365 and Slack.

It picks the best model for each task, ⁠currently running on Google's Gemini models and ⁠Anthropic's Claude models, with other models to be added later.

Users can create "coworker agents" ​that act as ‌team members, with their own email address and access only to the information they are given.

Versions built for financial services and legal work are now in ​preview, and versions for government, ‌healthcare and retail are coming soon. [...] In this article

Alphabet's Google Cloud on Thursday introduced the Gemini agent, a single AI agent for work ⁠that can answer questions, handle tasks, create content and write ​code.

The move comes ​as tech ​companies race to sell AI that can work autonomously.

The announcement comes after OpenAI's September launch of always-on ⁠agents ‌called dots that chase user goals ⁠across apps on their own. Earlier last month, Meta released Muse, a personal AI agent that can shop, book travel, ‌send emails and make payments for users.

Alphabet shares were up marginally in early trading.

The Gemini agent plans the work, uses tools, connects to a company's business systems and returns finished ⁠work in documents, email and developer environments, Google said.

results.title: Google announces 'Gemini agent' as ‘universal agent for work’
results.content:
Besides functioning as a personal assistant, the Gemini agent can serve as a “team member, where it works on behalf of a group of people, like a project manager within a team, or on behalf of a specific role in an organization, like an analyst in your finance department.”

Under-the-hood, the Gemini agent “runs each job on the model that fits best.” This includes both the Gemini and Claude families of models today with support for other private and open models in the future. This is meant to “deliver optimal quality and lower your costs.” It uses sub-agents to “tackle multi-step tasks” and connects with various third-party tools. [...] Go to the 9to5Google home page

# Google Cloud announces ‘Gemini agent’ as ‘universal agent for work’

Avatar for Abner Li  Abner Li | Oct 8 2026 - 5:00 am PT

0 Comments

 

At Gemini at Work 2026, Google Cloud today announced the “Gemini agent” for enterprise customers.

Gemini agent is a “new single, universal agent for work” available in the Gemini Enterprise app, Workspace, and third-party services. Google says you can “give it objectives, not instructions.” It can answer questions, handle knowledge work, create media, and write/run code.

Google Cloud has introduced the Google Cloud Gemini agent, a single agent for enterprise work. The Gemini agent is a cloud-hosted agent from Google Cloud that answers questions, does knowledge work, creates media, and writes and runs code. It does all of this from 1 prompt box and 1 API. For developers, the agent is the product and the model is a routing decision.

## TL;DR [...] ## TL;DR

 Runs on: Google Cloud (AI Hypercomputer). Reached from web, mobile, desktop, CLI, Workspace, Microsoft 365, Slack, or headless.
 Best: Bloomberg Media lifted SQL query accuracy by 63% by grounding data agents in Knowledge Catalog.
 Bottom line:
  + Best: 1 governed agent with cloud memory, sub-agents and hard spend caps.
  + Worst: buyers must evaluate it on customer anecdotes, not reproducible numbers.

## What is the Google Cloud Gemini agent?

It is a delegation layer, not a chatbot. You give it objectives, not instructions. It plans the work, picks skills and tools, connects to company systems, and returns finished output.
